scope: Post-hoc explanatory control: train-calibrated per-view global translation of frozen probabilities
seed_selection: First originally fixed seed ID; one-seed new-question exploration, not selected for effect size
fitted_parameters: Four integer (dy,dx) pairs, one per view, shared by all regions
search: Each dy and dx is an integer in [-32,32], inclusive; no expansion
fit_objective: Mean over 256 training tiles of fixed-weight mean pixel BCE on the same central 384x384 support
tie_break: Within 1e-12 of minimum, minimize squared shift length, then dy, then dx
shift_convention: q[y,x]=p[y+dy,x+dx]; ground targets unchanged; no wrap, padding or interpolation
support: Require previously verified full valid 448x448 masks; stop on change, do not drop regions
tta: Use r018 complete inverse-rotated maps; apply same anchor shift to base and inverse-rotated prediction before averaging
primary: D=I_zero_core-I_aligned_core on actual cached labels; positive means reduced crossed contrast
secondary: Residual I, delta_A/B, TTA gains, per-view/pair risk improvement and IoU; direct448 label sensitivity with identical shifts and weights
statistics: One existing seed; tile mean within block, equal 16 blocks; PCG64(17017),20000 paired draws, frozen manifest first-occurrence block order
interpretation: Already-used evaluation set; descriptive post-hoc explanation, no fresh confirmation or causal explained fraction
